 'Healthy' Jennifer Lopez says ‘I can do whatever I want’ after Ben Affleck split
 Months after her public split from Ben Affleck, Jennifer Lopez took to The Tonight Show, where she spoke to Jimmy Fallon about her new life as an empty-nester as she enjoys some 'me' time
 Add to preferred sources Entertainment Kathleen O'Boyle Entertainment/Showbiz Reporter 01:09 ET, 16 Nov 2026 Updated 01:47 ET, 16 Nov 2026 View 2 Images J. Lo visited Jimmy Fallon (Image: NBC) 
 During her recent visit to The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon, music icon Jennifer Lopez opened up about her life being a single mom to two college students.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 The comments come over a year after her split with Ben Affleck , who she has been on and off with for decades in between other relationships. “It’s the first time since like my early 20s that I haven’t been with someone...I’m alone, I’m free. I can do whatever the f—. I...,” Lopez , 57, told Fallon as she cut herself off. “It's like amazing, but also weird, but also amazing,” she finished.
 Speaking on making new music, she said, “It’s just a very healthy time in my life. I’m on my own. I feel like it’s another coming of age.” This comes as she prepares to release her new film special. 
 READ MORE : Jennifer Lopez fans set for 'iconic Thanksgiving' as singer unveils 'intimate' film READ MORE : Jennifer Lopez and Brett Goldstein reportedly dating after starring in raunchy rom-com She also added that when her twins went off to college, she was "having so many feelings and emotions" that it inspired her to "go into the studio and start playing around."
 Subsequently, Fallon questioned the star on whether or not she would tour the new music. "I will be going on tour next summer, I believe," she teased. "It just happened...like a couple days ago...I think it's happening."
 Content cannot be displayed without consent ‌ 
 Viewers at home reacted to Lopez's comments on social media. One person wrote, "Loving this interview with Jennifer Lopez #FallonTonight." "Aww I love the whole interview," someone else gushed.
 A third fan said, "I know Jimmy loves having her on the show, they always do such a memorable skit together!"
 ‌ 
 "JLo is always down to have a fun time with Jimmy. She’s so awesome," one more fan noted.
 The visit came a year after Lopez split from longtime on-again-off-again beau, Ben Affleck. J Lo and Affleck officially divorced in 2025 after almost two years of marriage and decades of dating on and off.
 ‌ 
 View 2 Images J Lo bragged that she can 'do whatever she wants'
 The pair cited fundamental differences in lifestyle, privacy preferences, and communication for the reason they split.
 Earlier this year, Lopez took blame for her split from Affleck. During a conversation alongside Jason Bateman, Sean Hayes and Will Arnett on the crew's Smartless podcast, Lopez reflected on her time with Affleck and how their split went down.
 "There's been different times where I felt like, whether people outside knew it or not, where I feel like my life blew up in my own face, and it was because of the choices I made," she said. "But also because of the fact that I had things that needed to change about myself that I didn't understand or recognize that was attracting certain things and attracting a certain type of experience into my life."
 Lopez shares fraternal twins Max and Emme, born February 22, 2008, with her ex-husband Marc Anthony. The 18-year-old siblings just set off for college this year, leaving Lopez an empty nester for the first time.
